purpose: Pinned Node backend and frontend application snapshots for v0.5.0. Step 130 owns independent review of scope and finding expectations.
identityMethod: Sorted recursive entries (directories, regular file bytes/executable bit, symlink text), SHA-256 over compact JSON; no symlink traversal; no .git/node_modules inputs.

acquisition.method: git bare shallow fetch of the recorded commit, git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD and commit tree verification, git archive --format=tar <commit>, SHA-256 and data-only extraction

projects.rationale: Single-package TypeScript Fastify API with server startup, database migration and test scripts and an ESLint flat configuration.
reviewAreas: Fastify directory autoload, logger transport by string, and database client selection are runtime conventions.
Inherited TypeScript configuration, ambient Node types and the nested glob/tsx test command require separate review.
